entries.title: The Blood Furnace
body: The answer to the mystery of the fel orcs' growing numbers lies here, in the Blood Furnace beneath Hellfire Citadel. Magtheridon's tainted blood is drained and pooled, and the fel orcs are made with it, a new army of barbaric warriors stronger and more savage than the Horde that drank Mannoroth's blood long ago.

entries.title: The Cells
body: Holding cells where fel orcs are kept and tested before they are loosed, watched over by the Maker, whose experiments make them, and by Broggok, a floating eye of corruption behind its gate.

entries.title: The Furnace
body: The heart of the furnace, where Magtheridon's jailor holds his circle of channellers drawing the pit lord's power.

entries.title: The Maker
body: The fel orc who oversees the making of the new breed in the Blood Furnace.

entries.title: Broggok
body: A great floating eye that watches over the Blood Furnace's cells, spewing poison. It promised, in Zeth'Gor, to meet those who came for it in the citadel.

entries.title: Keli'dan the Breaker
body: The fel orc jailor of Magtheridon, master of the Blood Furnace.
